_doc: S. BANG dating cabinet (#31, Wave D, built 2026-07-17-eve; roster #37). Copenhagen's high-grade two-man house: Svend Bang's shop opened 1968, brand pipes from 1970 (Per Hansen 1970 + Ulf Noltensmeier 1971), Hansen+Noltensmeier took over 1984, retirement announced November 2019 (no continuation planned) = ceiling 2020. TWO strong levers: (1) the 1984 stamp switch COPENHAGEN (English) -> KØBENHAVN (Danish); (2) US-market pipes carry YEAR+NUMBER codes + carver stamp: '9736'+PH = 36th pipe by Per Hansen in 1997 -> PERCEPTION RULE: pass the FIRST TWO digits of the 4-digit US stamp as date_code_suffix (engine code_table decodes to an EXACT year; unknown code -> honest None). SOURCES: staging/pipedia/S__Bang.json (Danish Pipemakers article, detailed) + smokingpipes 'End of an Era' (Stanion, Nov-2019, cited therein) + artisan registry (s-bang-workshop).

history_anchors._doc: Svend Bang: tobacco trade from 1941 (wartime); after the war at W.Ø. LARSEN where he BUILT the Larsen pipe workshop (bedrock of Danish freehand fame — wo_larsen link). 1968: own shop opens (Astley's tobacco agency financed it); repairs first, then hires carvers: Peter Rafn (~6 months), Ivan Holst Nielsen, Jan Windelov, Ph. Vigen (short stays, mostly ex-Nørding). 1970 PER HANSEN (b.1948, ex-Hartmann + ~2 months Preben Holm) stays; 1971 ULF NOLTENSMEIER (b.1948, German, ex-Preben Holm 1970 + 15 months Anne Julie). Grading system introduced by Svend Bang 1970. End 1975 workshop overflows -> 1976 move to Struenseegade 9 (Copenhagen N, still there). ~1976/77: Svend Bang personally makes the LÖFBERG pipes (his wife's maiden name) — rejected by distributor Otto & Kopp, forgotten ~28 years, surfaced 2005 via Oliver Kopp/Volker Bier; authenticity confirmed by Hansen+Noltensmeier: Löfberg = made by Svend Bang IN PERSON. 1978 Piber & Tobak magazine co-founded by Bang. 1984 Svend Bang retires; Hansen+Noltensmeier take over, KEEP the name, switch the stamp COPENHAGEN -> KØBENHAVN. Svend Bang dies 1993. November 2019: retirement announced after ~50 years — no continuation. Process: all-handwork, black hand-cut vulcanite stems, double staining; Hansen does all sandblasting AT STANWELL's facility (stanwell link); own silverwork.

brand_marks.physical: Shank: S. BANG + city. EUROPEAN-market grades ascending: Black blast, Tan blast, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, A, B, C, rare D. US-market: NO grade — year+serial code + carver stamp (PH = Per Hansen, UN = Ulf Noltensmeier). All stems black hand-cut vulcanite.

date_code._doc: US-market S. Bang code: 4-digit 'YYnn' (YY = year, nn = that carver's pipe number) + PH/UN stamp. Perception passes YY (first two digits) as date_code_suffix -> exact year via the table (1970-2019 production window). A full 4-digit passed whole misses the table -> honest None.

line_years._notes: löfberg: Svend Bang's personal pipes, made ~1976/77 -> [1975,1978] with slack; surfaced for sale 2005 (sale date is NOT the making date). Grade letters/numbers span eras -> never encoded as lines.

table.label: English 'COPENHAGEN' stamp = the Svend Bang era (1970 first brand pipes -> 1984 takeover)
Danish 'KØBENHAVN' stamp = Hansen+Noltensmeier era (the ONLY change they made at the 1984 takeover); ceiling 2020 (retirement announced Nov-2019)

stamped_year._doc: Generic channel (the US YYnn code is handled by date_code).

channels_future.carver_split: PH vs UN stamps = per-carver attribution (value layer; both windows 1970/71-2019).
